admission.justification: One census case asserts the Curator role text's own route clauses — the mounted knowledge_write among the authoring routes, and the sentence that no other route writes knowledge — and a second asserts the role's writer admission by reference to its operation. A role text that denies the route it is told to use sends each curator pass back to a command that refuses its raise.

applicability: The Curator role, its admitted record-writing tools and the operation/detail instructions that govern normal authoring and correct-write recovery.
conditions: Use the primary tool first and correct faulty input through the same tool.
For a covered correct-input write refusal, retain the refusal, verify serving build/route/target/input class and try an honest admitted route.

Only the same refused tool/input class permits open manual recovery after prior owner notice, with actual inputs/refusals/write/provenance, every working check and issue row retained; claim no tool receipt and the next Curator re-records.
Normal decisions/writes remain on the admitted serving build with task contract/list, persisted worklist and file-commit semantics.
exclusions: A missing or unadmitted writer capability.
Denied/unanswered permission, read/check/validation/sync refusals, starts, unrelated product guards and commit gates.
Older-build check evasion, hidden edits, false tool authorship, weakened false claims or other input classes.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_curator_instruction_wording.py and mcp/tests/test_role_capsule_budgets.py, both passed 2026-10-21; the capsules still compile at 3698 / 3142 / 2458 words and no capsule grew

statement: The Curator's instructions require the mounted writer or admitted serving-build CLI for normal knowledge authoring and allow only disclosed same-tool/input-class recovery after a covered correct-input write refusal.
